name: biz.drivo/drivo-erp
title: Drivo ERP
description: Secure MCP server for the Drivo dealer platform: vehicles, customers, CRM, deals, service.

environmentVariables.name: DRIVO_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Drivo API, e.g. https://demo.drivo.biz

environmentVariables.name: DRIVO_MCP_PRINCIPALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the principals JSON (hashed API keys, scopes, company allowlist).

environmentVariables.name: DRIVO_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Drivo MCP API key (a principal in the principals file).

environmentVariables.name: DRIVO_MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Random secret (>=16 chars) that signs high-risk confirmation tokens.
